scope: Remove remaining pre-acceptance decimal rounding from analytic SPICE calculations: RC time constants, SY7201 current setting, buck feedback voltage, enable ceiling/turn-on and BOOT0 strap voltage
changes: Removed seven rounding call sites; no py_round remains in native/src/spice.cpp
All analytic values retain calculation precision through limits, JSON and simulator agreement checks
Shared test-only historical precision metadata preserves existing fixtures without reintroducing production rounding
Generated test-plan tests verify the current analytic values in their corresponding rows and compare an isolated historical presentation view for legacy structure
negative_control: Before the fix, the new regression failed with 'rounded acceptance at RC'; native/build/spice-all-precision-red.log

boundary_coverage.boundaries: RC lower/upper; ISET lower/upper; feedback lower/upper; unclamped enable ceiling; zener enable turn-on/ceiling; BOOT0 lower
boundary_coverage.offsets: For each boundary: minus 0.4 of the former rounding step, minus 1e-7, zero, plus 1e-7, plus 0.4 step in the check's existing unit
boundary_coverage.independent_construction: Resistor values calculated from the inverse equations for the target value; forward extraction must reproduce the target within floating representation error
boundary_coverage.rounded_negative_controls: Each of the twenty rejected outside cases would pass if its result were rounded using the former step; the tests assert both facts

validation.targeted_spice_suite: 50 retained fixtures, nine tolerance vectors, six live ngspice comparisons and 4460 exact assertions

limits: Existing electrical thresholds, comparison tolerances, model constants, component values and connectivity unchanged
Improved arithmetic precision does not improve the physical fidelity of approximate models or establish exhaustive electrical coverage
No board placement changed, no smaller carrier accepted, no fabrication-readiness claim
Full rendering/source-audit qualification and matched historical Python benchmarks not rerun for this calculation correction
